summary.zh-TW: 兩排大字一左一右無限輪播，第二排是空心字。滑鼠移上去會慢慢減速，移開再加速回來；右下角有暫停鈕，可以讓兩排一起慢慢停下。
summary.en: Two rows of big type loop forever in opposite directions, the second in outline. Hovering eases it down to a crawl and moving away speeds it back up. A Pause button eases both rows to a stop.

text.zh-TW: 一排放兩份一模一樣的內容。第一份剛好跑出畫面時，第二份正好接在原位，從頭重來也看不出接縫。
text.en: Each row holds two identical copies. When the first has fully scrolled out, the second sits exactly where it started, so the restart is seamless.

text.zh-TW: 移動的距離剛好是「一份內容的寬度」，ease 用 none 等速，repeat: -1 無限重複。
text.en: It moves exactly one copy’s width, linearly (ease: none), repeating forever (repeat: -1).

text.zh-TW: timeScale 是動畫的播放速度。不直接暫停，而是用另一個補間慢慢把速度降下來，感覺像踩剎車。
text.en: timeScale is the playback speed. Instead of pausing, another tween eases it down — like braking rather than stopping dead.

text.zh-TW: 時間用「寬度 ÷ 速度」算，內容長短不同的兩排，看起來的移動速度才會一樣。
text.en: Duration is width ÷ speed, so rows with different lengths move at the same visual speed.

text.zh-TW: 暫停鈕也用 timeScale：慢慢停下、慢慢開始，不是突然定格。一直在動的內容要能讓人停下來（WCAG 2.2.2：會動超過 5 秒的東西要能暫停），對容易分心或暈眩的人很重要。
text.en: The Pause button also tweens timeScale, so the rows ease to a stop and back instead of freezing. Content that keeps moving needs a way to stop it (WCAG 2.2.2: anything moving longer than 5 seconds must be pausable) — important for people who get distracted or dizzy.
